lines.text: Pour juice into water, stir, then pour some back.
lines.caption: Pour juice into water, stir, then pour some back.

lines.text: Most kids get the final mix wrong!
lines.caption: Most kids get the final mix wrong!

lines.text: Jug A holds ten liters of water. Jug B holds ten liters of sixty percent juice.
lines.caption: Jug A holds ten liters of water. Jug B holds ten liters of sixty percent juice.

lines.text: Pour five liters from B to A, stir, then pour five back. What percent of B is juice?
lines.caption: Pour five liters from B to A, stir, then pour five back. What percent of B is juice?

lines.text: The trick: count liters of juice, not percents.
lines.caption: The trick: count liters of juice, not percents.

lines.text: Jug B starts with six liters of juice. Half of B moves, so three liters of juice go over.
lines.caption: Jug B starts with six liters of juice. Half of B moves, so three liters of juice go over.

lines.text: Pour back one third of jug A. One liter of juice goes back to B.
lines.caption: Pour back one third of jug A. One liter of juice goes back to B.

lines.text: Jug B ends with three plus one, four liters of juice, out of ten.
lines.caption: Jug B ends with three plus one, four liters of juice, out of ten.
